meta.title: makeyourmindup: AI, unpicked
meta.description: We look under the hood, follow the money and mind the gap. You make your mind up. A free publication on how AI really works, every Monday, Wednesday and Friday.

subchannels.label: under.the.hood
subchannels.coverLine: Real, or theatre? We take it apart.
subchannels.oneLiner: How it gets built, and why it works.
subchannels.body: Every Monday we open up something that shipped and actually works. Every part gets a stamp, real or theatre, so you can see what does the work and what is there for the launch video.
subchannels.question: What actually goes together in a shipped thing, and why did this one work?
subchannels.caption: Illustration. The real ones show the evidence for every stamp.
headline: Real, or
theatre?
We take it apart.

subchannels.label: follow.the.money
subchannels.coverLine: Who gets paid when AI gets bought.
subchannels.oneLiner: How money gets made with AI, and by whom.
subchannels.body: Every AI deal has a bill, and somebody pays it. Every Wednesday we trace the money from the invoice to the bank account, and show who comes out ahead and who gets stuck with the tab.
subchannels.question: Where does the money move, and who ends up better or worse off?
subchannels.caption: Illustration. The real ones name every source.
headline: Who gets paid
when AI gets
bought.

subchannels.label: mind.the.gap
subchannels.oneLiner: The patterns, and where they lead.
subchannels.body: Most weeks, a pile of AI stories look like they have nothing to do with each other. Every Friday we lay the threads side by side, show where they cross, and put a date on what we think happens next.
subchannels.question: What is the pattern, and what does it mean is coming?
subchannels.caption: Illustration. The real ones come with dates and sources.
headline: What's coming,
before it's
obvious.

scoreboard.title: Every piece makes a call. We keep score.
scoreboard.body: Each piece ends with a prediction, a date and how sure we are. When the date arrives, we mark it held, broke or unclear. Misses go up as big as hits.
scoreboard.empty: The board opens with the first piece.
